snippet.title: They Looked Like Us [Official Release Trailer]
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD: https://jamjarisdumb.itch.io/they-looked-like-us

An emergency broadcast urges people to stay inside and follow careful instructions to survive. Turn the lights off and close the curtains, do not let them find you.

Over the last few weeks I have been working on a short horror game for a college assignment. I was encouraged by friends and family to publish the finished game publically for people to play. This is my first fully finished horror game. However, due to my project deadline the game is rather short. That being said, I hope you enjoy!

Music used for trailer: https://freesound.org/people/ChristmasKrumble666/sounds/748215/
